progress_philosophy: In this app, we have intentionally decided not to include a lifetime progress tracker or 'scoreboard'. While consistency is beloved to Allah, we want your focus to remain entirely on the presence of your heart, not the accumulation of numbers. Worship is a private, intimate conversation with the Almighty, and a Muslim's intention must remain pure from self-amazement ('Ujub). We provide the tools to help you fulfill the daily Sunnah targets, but we leave the ultimate accounting to Allah.
tap_to_test_notif: Tap to see if notifications work

onboarding_desc_2: Begin your journey of daily remembrance with a focused and peaceful mind.
onboarding_desc_3: Customize the standard morning and evening sets or build your own personal routine.

donation_pitch_1: This app is free for everyone. If it has helped bring peace to your day, consider becoming a Patron for
donation_pitch_2: to help us keep it ad-free and cover server costs so thousands of others can benefit.
donation_thank_you: Thank you for your donation! Achievement unlocked.
parents_note_body: While the Quranic verses above are the most perfect words to use, you are not restricted to them. You may supplicate for your parents in your own language at any time, especially during Sujood (prostration) or in the last third of the night. You can ask Allah to grant them health, lengthen their lives in obedience to Him, grant them Jannatul Firdaus (the highest paradise), and protect them from the trials of the grave and the Hereafter.
graveyard_note_body: After reciting the greetings above, you may stand, preferably facing the Qiblah, and make personal du'a in your own words for the forgiveness and mercy of the deceased, particularly your family members and loved ones. Raise your hands and ask Allah to expand their graves and grant them Paradise.
donation_hadith_ar: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
donation_hadith_translation: The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those done regularly, even if small.
donation_for_you_title: Give for you, and for those you love
donation_for_you_body: Every dhikr counted and every prayer reminded through this app becomes a running charity — sadaqah jariyah — whose reward keeps reaching you, and can be gifted to your parents, your children, and everyone you love, even after you're gone.
donation_choose_tier: Choose how you'd like to support
donation_why_body: Adhkaar 365 is 100% free and will always stay ad-free — but it isn't free to run. Hosting the app for thousands of users, translations in 19 languages, verified Arabic audio for every dua, prayer-time servers, and constant updates all cost real money, every single month. Your donation is what keeps it alive.
donation_multiply_body: Right now, somewhere, someone is opening this app for their morning adhkar. Someone else, for the evening. Every dhikr they recite and every prayer they're reminded of is a reward reaching them — and reaching you too, because your support is what kept the app running for them. Keep it alive, and you keep sharing in every reward it brings, every morning, every evening, for as long as it keeps reminding people of Allah — in shā' Allāh.
